mappings.reason: Ideal op-amp infinite bandwidth is legacy electronics with no direct lesson in topics 12-25. Closest active home is AC period/frequency/peak lesson as bandwidth concerns uniform amplification across all frequencies.

Ideal op-amp infinite slew rate is legacy electronics with no direct lesson. Closest active home is AC sinusoidal variation lesson as slew rate concerns instantaneous rate of change of output voltage with time.

Op-amp comparator balance to find RT at VOUT=0 is legacy electronics. Closest active pedagogical home is temperature measurement via temperature-dependent physical property including resistance, covering thermistor context.

Variation of comparator VOUT with thermistor resistance is legacy op-amp saturation behaviour. Closest active home is temperature-resistance measurement lesson for thermistor resistance change with temperature.
LED connection at op-amp output to indicate RT threshold is legacy op-amp application. Closest active home is diode rectification lesson which explicitly teaches diode action and symbols.
